CDBG Planning Grants

Contact:

Contact Name
contact@example.virginia.gov

DHCD offers planning grants through the CDBG program to increase the potential for project success and impact. These grants aid in developing clearly articulated strategies for addressing a locality’s greatest community development needs following meaningful citizen participation. For more details, see the section on Planning Grants in the CDBG Program Design Manual.

See the most recently awarded CDBG Project and Planning Grants
Eligibility

Non-entitlement units of local government are the only eligible recipients of Virginia CDBG funding, but these local governments may contract with Planning District Commissions, nonprofit organizations, and other competent entities to undertake project activities. A funding amount of $1,000,000 is allocated for CDBG Planning Grants. 

There are two categories of Planning Grants, which may or may not be used in preparation for a future CDBG competitive application submission:

  • Activation Planning Grants
  • Project-Driven Planning Grants

Activation Planning Grants (formerly called "Community Needs Assessments"/"Overall Assessments") are to utilize public input to determine a locality's highest priority needs and plans for future implementation. Project-Drive Planning Grants are directly tied to DHCD's CDBG Competitive and Open Submission Projects (Business District Redevelopment, Housing Rehab, Comprehensive Community Development, Public Infrastructure, Public Services, and Economic Development) and are to increase a prior identified project's readiness. Applications are accepted on an open, rolling basis from May 10 to November 15th , or until all the funding has been allocated for the program year, whichever one comes first. They must be submitted electronically through DHCD’s Centralized Application and Management System (CAMS) and are reviewed on a monthly schedule.

Please contact DHCD prior to the submission of any application.
